Cookies

Last updated 21 October 2026

This site doesn't use cookies, so there's no cookie banner and nothing to accept or decline.

What is stored in your browser

One small thing, and it never leaves your device:

  • zc-loaded: a flag in your browser's session storage. It remembers that the opening animation has already played in this tab, so it doesn't repeat each time you come back to the home page. It holds no personal information, isn't sent to any server, and is deleted when you close the tab.

What isn't used

  • No analytics or visitor tracking
  • No advertising or marketing cookies
  • No third-party scripts, embeds or fonts

If that changes

If I ever add anything that sets cookies or stores data beyond the above, I'll update this page and ask for your consent first where the law requires it.

Questions: zcbarakat@gmail.com.
